description: Save the bytes of a thumbnail at any size or the original file to a local folder and return the path (plus sha256, and base64 for small files when asked). The image URLs need the signed-in cookies, so always fetch through this tool.

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

output_dir.description: Local folder to save into. Default: <tmp>/google_photos_downloads.

return_base64.description: true to also inline the bytes (files up to 1.5 MB).

size.description: original for the uploaded file (photo or video, byte-exact), or a size spec such as w512-h512, s1024, w2048-h2048-no for an image/thumbnail. Default w512-h512.

name: download_media
